selection_population: unchanged cumulative C5 plus individual jet multiplicity, pT and eta predicates
mass_category_semantics: low inclusive, high exclusive, except exact160 belongs to final category; disconnected support
trim_semantics: both outer bounds inclusive; central excluded; overlapping diagnostics are not independent
fold_rule: SHA256(canonical_identity_ascii), first digest byte low bit: 0=calibration, 1=validation
fold_contract: whole-cache run/event uniqueness; each sideband identity in exactly one fold; no mass-dependent assignment
calibration_role: fixed descriptive statistics only; no parameter fitting or boundary choice
validation_role: same prespecified statistics and fold shape comparison; retrospective population already viewed
unbinned_diagnostics: Pearson and exact-tied-average-rank Spearman; empirical two-sample KS D over sidebands, no pvalues
binned_diagnostics: 2-by-9 A/B contingency Cramers V, omit only zero-total columns from statistic; full inventory retained; degenerate tables UNDEFINED
conditional_shapes: raw n_i/N for each partition/fold, all nine categories; covariance (delta_ij*p_i-p_i*p_j)/N conditional on fixed N
count_uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for per-category A occupancy; sqrt(n) raw-count uncertainty descriptive only; no systematics
sparsity: explicit zero cells, cells below5, and undefined states; no asymptotic chi-square or continuous-null KS inference
